name: threatready
description: Threatready data security training platform: NestJS API, React SPA and shared contracts (npm workspaces).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @threatready/contracts && npm run build -w @threatready/api && npm run build -w threatready-web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @threatready/contracts && npm run dev -w @threatready/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @threatready/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @threatready/api && npm run typecheck -w threatready-web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @threatready/contracts && npm run test -w @threatready/api && npm run test -w threatready-web
